name: Nehemiah
author: Largely Nehemiah’s own memoir.
setting: Nehemiah, a cupbearer to the Persian king, returns to rebuild Jerusalem’s walls.
theme: God’s people rebuild by prayer, courage, and reading the law together.

outline.label: The king’s permission and the night inspection
The reading of the law and the Feast of Booths
Resettlement and the dedication of the wall

christInBook: Nehemiah left a position of comfort to rebuild his people’s city, and points to Christ, who left heaven to restore his people. The public reading of the law (chapter 8) points to the word of God that renews the heart.
howToRead: Nehemiah is a leadership story. Notice how prayer and action go side by side, and how opposition grows as the work succeeds.
